profile.summary: Anthropic is a San Francisco-based AI company founded in 2021 that sells its Claude models, Claude Code and Claude Cowork through subscriptions, APIs and cloud platforms. Its Series H raised $65B at a $965B post-money valuation in May 2026, and it has filed a confidential draft registration statement with the SEC as a first step toward a possible listing. The company has about 2,500 employees and is led by CEO Dario Amodei.
